capabilities: Publish mapped notes and images to a GitHub repository
Map local vault paths to remote repo paths in a mapping table
Batch sync all mapped files in a single Git commit
Convert WikiLinks to Markdown links and rewrite image links
Auto-push changes on save or when share: true is set
disambiguation: Not a Git backup or vault sync tool; it only publishes files that have explicit mappings or share: true to a target repo.
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation requires cloning the repository and building it manually with npm.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish selected vault notes as Markdown files and images to a GitHub repo that a static site generator builds from.

relations.evidence: compatible with Hugo, Jekyll, Hexo, and other static site generators
compatible with Hugo, Jekyll, Hexo, and other static site generators
compatible with Hugo, Jekyll, Hexo, and other static site generators

requires.name: GitHub Personal Access Token with repo scope
GitHub repository (owner and name) with write permissions

summary: Publishing tool that selectively pushes mapped notes and embedded images to a GitHub repository for Hugo, Jekyll, Hexo, and other static site generators.
